source.basis: Industry value-chain template + curated product/market rivals for HK MVP hubs (trial batch). Not a live supplier API dump. Prefer .HK dual-list counters on HK pages. Preview-before-merge.
source.notes_zh: 本頁為港股 MVP 龍頭供應鏈／競爭策展種子（產業價值鏈模板＋人工策展對手）。未呼叫即時供應商 API；FMP 同業名單不作價值鏈依據。雙重上市優先港股 .HK 代號。若主力市場在中國／亞洲，階段玩家與對手優先中港／區域上市，不以美股公司名單灌水。競爭對手採產品／市場真實對手原則（參考美股 AAPL 教訓）。
source.notes_en: HK MVP hub curated seed (industry value-chain template + curated rivals). No live supplier API. Dual-listed names prefer .HK. When the major market is China/Asia, stage players and rivals prefer CN/HK/regional listings — not US-company dumps. Competitors follow true product/market rivalry (AAPL lesson).
source.competitorRationale_zh: 競爭弧只列主力市場真實產品對手；階段玩家與對手分開；雙重上市優先 .HK；中國市場不以美股節點為預設。
source.competitorRationale_en: Rival arc = true product rivals in the major market; stages ≠ rivals; dual listings prefer .HK; China-facing hubs are not US-node dumps.

model.description_zh: 雲／網路基建 → 內容／遊戲 IP 上游 → 電信／裝置分發 → 支付清算 → 廣告主／商戶下游。
model.description_en: Cloud/network infra → content/game IP upstream → carrier/device distribution → payment clearing → advertiser/merchant demand.
